entries.020f5b98463c81c8: Centered on the department store business, and with the management philosophy of 'creating vitality as a regional hub for exchange and contributing to improving the living culture of customers in its market,' the company states that in the Ishikawa and Toyama area it will respond to regional customers' expectations through a product lineup and attractive sales planning that only the company can offer, and that it will promote a review of its expense structure and business efficiency to strengthen its earnings base. In the medium to long term, the company states that it will work to strengthen the development of 'new products and planning,' hold culturally rich art events, develop authentic-quality products for regional product fairs, and promote community-based sales through expanded initiatives with leading regional companies and producers; and that its group companies aim to establish 'independent management.'
